title: Speaking — Changes at home
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on changes at home.

questions: What do you usually do before leaving home?
At what time of day do you feel most alert?
Which part of your routine would you like to change?
Does your routine change during holidays?
Which room do you spend the most time in?
Is there anything you would like to change about your home?

part2.topic: Describe a change that made your home more comfortable.
points: how it affected the way you use the space
part2.closing: and explain why the improvement was worthwhile.

questions: What should architects consider when designing homes for several generations?
How can renters improve their living conditions when they cannot make major changes?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to changes at home?
